empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a reusable rule your agents apply during review. Write one or import it from a file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to see and edit it, or create a new one.

detail.evalsTooltip: Evals arrive in a later lesson
detail.deleteConfirm: Used by {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} — it will be unlinked from them.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.title: Preview
preview.caption: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.unsavedNote: You have unsaved edits — the preview shows the saved version.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes (e.g. uncovered-branches).
config.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — write it as a directive: 'Flag…', 'Check that…'.
config.bodyTooLong: Skill body is too long (max {max} characters).
config.usedBy: Used by {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} — changes apply to all of them.
config.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes to this skill. Leave without saving?
config.importedNotice: Imported from {file} — review the instructions: this text goes into your agents' prompts.
config.importedNoticeNoFile: Imported from a file — review the instructions: this text goes into your agents' prompts.

evals.emptyTitle: Evals for skills arrive in a later lesson.
evals.emptyBody: You will be able to score a skill against a set of labelled cases.

stats.caption: Last 30 days · runs this skill was part of
stats.noAgents: No agent uses this skill yet.
stats.noFindings: No findings from runs that used this skill.
stats.footnote: Correlation: findings from runs where this skill was in the prompt, not findings caused by it.

versions.title: Version history
versions.caption: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.restoreConfirm: Creates v{next} with the content of v{version}. History is kept.

import.title: Import skill from file
import.subtitle: Nothing is saved until you click Save.
import.dropTitle: Drop a .md or .zip file here, or click to choose
import.tooLarge: That file is larger than 1 MB.
import.wrongType: Only .md and .zip files can be imported.
import.name: Name

reason.non-skill-file: not part of the skill, not imported

import.nameConflict: A skill named “{name}” already exists. Rename this one to save it.
import.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes.
import.trust: This skill was written by someone else. Its text becomes instructions in your agents' prompts. Scripts and other files are never run or stored.
